verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature page claims cross-project visibility: 'visibility on your company's progress towards top priorities as projects advance' and connecting initiatives 'across every team'. These are thin marketing statements. Nothing documents a dedicated portfolio view or how progress rolls up across projects. Missing for 10: a documented portfolio or roll-up view, details of how multi-project progress is aggregated, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can roll up progress across multiple projects into a single portfolio view

citations.quote: Get visibility on your company's progress towards top priorities as projects advance
Connect engineering, product, and marketing initiatives to coordinate big launches across every team.
